text: Dorota is properly vegan now, not just weekdays. Also hates mushrooms. Bear in mind for the dinner on 14 May.
Tendai and his wife Rana hit ten years on June 3rd. remind me to sort that tasting menu voucher for them before end of May
pick up dry cleaning thurs, return the shoe parcel, renew car tax before 31/10
Marcus proposed to Carmen!!! on the beach in Lisbon last weekend. need to send a card. they're thinking a summer wedding, maybe 5/14 next year

okay so just got off the phone with Emeka um his sister Afua is getting married on the 3rd of June in Accra and he flies out on the 28th of May, he's best man and he's really stressing about the speech, I should check in with him the week before
Ava - coeliac, strict. Her husband Andre is allergic to shellfish. no prawns at the bbq
Kaito only drinks oolong, never coffee, and he's weirdly particular about water temperature. Secret santa idea: a nice tea set

Ruby's parents' 40th anniversary is 22 Nov, she's organising a party at the golf club and is completely frazzled. Her dad is coeliac and her mum won't touch anything with garlic, so the caterer is being a nightmare, and her brother Callum has done precisely nothing to help. don't forget to ask if she needs help with the cake, I could do the gluten free one
Layla's wedding is off. She and Gabriel split up end of last month and she's staying at her mum's for now.
gym 7am mon wed fri from now on, meal prep sundays
Sofia says Archie's doing Sober October so mocktails Saturday. He likes ginger beer, the really fiery kind.
Kerry & Chantal got engaged!! The ring was Chantal's nan's. Engagement party Nov 12th at her brother Rhys's place
Zeynep is lactose intolerant but obsessed with dark chocolate. Birthday 12th Dec, a box of the 85% stuff would go down well
Eamon and Petra's anniversary was Saturday, went to that new Italian in town. He said the food was meh, Petra loved it. Ask him what it's called

Long chat with Rohan at lunch. He and Pieter are finally doing the civil ceremony, 14/05 at the registry office in Leeds, tiny do with a meal after. He asked me to be a witness! He's nervous about the vows because Pieter is writing his own and Rohan reckons his will sound rubbish next to them. Pieter's veggie, Rohan eats anything. Must reply about the witness thing by Friday and offer to read his draft.
Chloe – no gluten, no nuts (anaphylactic, carries an EpiPen). Red wine person, Rioja especially.
Naledi and Abebe's anniversary Dec 2nd. Fifth, so wood. Engraved chopping board?
note to self cancel the streaming trial before Oct 28, book MOT for 3rd Nov, dentist moved to 11/11 at 9.40
Vera's dog Biscuit had three teeth out yesterday, soft food for a week. She's knackered and skint from the vet bill.

Callum rang. Stag is 7th-9th Nov in Krakow, wedding the 29th. His fiancee Wei is doing her hen in Edinburgh the same weekend, so the flat will be empty and he's asked me to feed their cat Pickle on the Saturday. He's skint after the deposit for the venue, and quite stressed about money generally. Maybe chip in for something off their list rather than a big gift.
Wei hates coriander, says it tastes like soap. Also not drinking at the moment, don't push wine on her.
text Marcus thursday to ask how the cake tasting went
Agnieszka's mum turns 70 on March 9 and is diabetic, so Agnieszka wants a sugar free cake recipe. send her the almond one
Emeka doesn't eat pork. Halal only.
Dr Gupta's leaving do got cancelled, apparently the department's being restructured instead. Petra thinks redundancies are coming in Jan.

voice memo. Andre and Ava are renewing their vows, ten ten next year, October 10th, same church as the original wedding. Andre asked if I'd play guitar for the walk in, which, gulp. Ava wants something acoustic and not cheesy. Their kids are doing readings. Need to start practising after Christmas and ask Ava which song.

grocery run: oat milk, lemons, the good bread, bin bags. collect prescription before 6. Then the tip with the old chair if there's time, it shuts at 4 on Sundays though, and I still need to repot the basil, sort the recycling, and finally email the landlord about the damp in the bathroom before the inspection on 2nd November.
Tendai's daughter is getting married in Harare on the 19th of December and he's flying out on the 12th. He looked so proud.
Rana texted, she and Tendai want to do dinner 4th Nov to celebrate their anniversary properly. I'm booking the Thai place. Rana's off spicy food since the stomach thing so ask for mild.
Carmen loves negronis. Hates prosecco. Noted for the engagement drinks.

So Archie and Sofia have set a date, 6/21/27, at her uncle's vineyard. Archie's terrified of the first dance, he has two left feet. Sofia wants lessons. Gift hint from Sofia: they've got no decent wine glasses.
call mum re: sunday lunch
Kerry is pescatarian these days, still eats eggs. Her partner Chantal does keto and is grumpy about it.
Layla seemed better today. Started a pottery class Tuesdays. Still not eating much, her sister Naledi is worried.
Must ring Callum before the 29th to wish him luck, he admitted he hasn't written his vows yet
Rhys and Zeynep's first anniversary is Saturday. Paper. Maybe frame a print of their wedding venue.
Reminder for me - council tax direct debit changes on 1 Nov, and the boiler service is Wed 28/10 between 8 and 12
Gabriel is a massive coffee snob, only drinks flat whites from the place by the station. Allergic to kiwi of all things.

Met Pieter's mum at the market, lovely woman, chatted for ages by the cheese stall. She's gluten free, can't do onions either, and her husband is recovering from a hip replacement, op was 2 weeks ago, he's apparently a terrible patient. She mentioned their 50th anniversary is on 9 January and Pieter's planning a meal. I should ask Pieter if he wants help booking.
Rohan's wedding cake tasting is 5/2. He wants me there because Pieter can't make it, he's away on a work trip till May 4th. I'm going.
Dorota and Kaito celebrated their anniversary last night with an omakase thing, Kaito said it cost a fortune. Need to ask Dorota how it was, she was nervous about raw fish.
Andre doesn't drink at all, never has. Likes elderflower cordial.
Book the venue for my own birthday drinks, thinking 15 Nov. Check if the upstairs room at the Crown is free.
Afua sent the wedding photos, they look stunning. Her husband Rhys looked like he was about to cry the whole ceremony. They met at uni in Manchester.
Ruby nervous about the anniversary party speech on the 22nd. I said I'd help her practise Thursday evening.
Chantal's grandad died last week. Funeral is 30/10. She's devastated, they were really close. Send flowers to her mum's address.
Agnieszka is gluten free and Kerry is vegetarian; book somewhere that does both for Friday 6th.
Engagement party for Emeka and Layla! Dec 5th, at Emeka's flat. Bring something, maybe a bottle of the Ghanaian gin he likes.
Eamon's taken up sourdough, very proud of his starter, calls it Doughvid. Not a pet.
Vera's 25th wedding anniversary is August 14th next year - silver - her son Callum is planning a surprise. Keep it quiet when I see her.
Text Sofia to ask whether Archie survived the first dance lesson last night lol
Wei and Callum's wedding date moved from Nov 29th to April 3rd because the venue flooded. Wei is gutted, cried on the phone. remind me to check in with her this weekend
returned library books. still need to sort passport renewal, it expires 2/3/27 and I've got the Lisbon trip in Feb
Marcus says Carmen's mum doesn't eat meat but eats fish, and her dad is diabetic. Christmas dinner at theirs, I'm doing dessert.
Rana's niece Chloe got engaged to her girlfriend Ruby in Paris, very romantic apparently. Rana's thrilled.

Uncle Abebe and Auntie Naledi celebrate 30 years on 3/12. Kids are throwing a lunch at the Ethiopian place on the Sunday after. don't forget to RSVP by the 20th of November and to get a card everyone can sign.
Kerry Baker from work - Kez - just told me she's eloping to Vegas Nov 21st, only her brother Rhys knows. She wants mocha cupcakes for the office goodbye, she's not a fan of vanilla.
Sat next to Wei at the quiz. Honestly she ordered chips and a lemonade and that was it, says she's gone off curry completely.
Tendai's wife Rana is due in March! Second baby. She's off caffeine and craving ice lollies constantly.

Zeynep said Eamon's struggling since his engagement ended, drinking a lot. She wants us to take him out for a meal, not the pub. I should text him tomorrow and suggest the curry house Saturday 31st, he loves a lamb madras.
